title: Bolt, the dog who thought he was a hero.
lines: Bolt is a little white dog with a black lightning bolt on his side.
He thinks he has laser eyes.
That he can bark super loudly.
So loudly that cars fall over.
But really Bolt is a dog in a television series.
One day Bolt thinks Penny has been kidnapped.
And the box is taken far away by a lorry.
To another city, on the other side of the country.
Bolt wants to get back to Penny.
A street cat with black fur.
Mittens knows everything about the city.
Bolt thinks Mittens is a bad guy.
He ties her up with a rope.
On the way they meet a hamster in a plastic ball.
Rhino has seen Bolt on television.
He thinks Bolt is the greatest hero in the world!
He looks with his laser eyes.
But Mittens teaches him something new.
She teaches him to be a real dog.
Hanging your head out of the car window.
Begging for treats with sweet eyes.
Being an ordinary dog is actually great fun.
At last they arrive at the studio.
Penny is trapped in the building.
But he does have a big heart.
He barks as loud as he can through an air vent.
She moves to a house in the countryside.
